query: SELECT s.userId, u.koreanName, s.year, s.month, s.division, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(s.week1Sales) as w1, SUM(s.week2Sales) as w2 FROM sales_records s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.userId = u.id GROUP BY s.userId, u.koreanName, s.year, s.month, s.division ORDER BY s.year DESC, s.month DESC;
